articleTitle: Keynote I
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Provides an abstract of the keynote presentation and may include a brief professional biography of the presenter. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Metaheuristics Optimization Algorithm to an Optimal Moroccan Diet
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this work, we propose a well-balanced diet basing on very simple quadratic optimization model which controls the lack of favorable nutrients, the excess of unfavorable nutrients, and which minimizes the total glycemic load of the diet. To solve the proposed mathematical model, we call well-known metaheuristic methods: genetic algorithm, firly algorithm, particle swarm algorithm, stochastic fractal search, and moth swarm algorithm with specific operators. The parameters of these algorithms are experimentally chosen. These algorithms have been tested on 176 foods available on the Moroccan market. Firly has shown its superiority over other methods in its ability to quickly design a well-balanced diet with an acceptable glycemic load.

articleTitle: Prediction of Air Pollutant Concentration Based on Luong Attention Mechanism Seq2Seq Model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In view of the low accuracy and unstable effect of traditional deep learning prediction model in air quality prediction, this paper proposes a Sequence to Sequence (seq2seq) model based on the Luong attention mechanism. Firstly, this paper uses data of daily observation from 41 observation stations in Chongqing from 2017 to 2018 to conduct prediction experiments, and analyze the correlation between environmental factors and each pollutant concentration. Then use the Horlzworth's dry adiabatic curve method to find the maximum mixed layer thickness and add it to environmental factors to predict air quality. Finally, the average absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) are used as evaluation indicators. Compared with other prediction models, the results show that the Seq2Seq model based on Luong attention mechanism with the maximum mixed layer thickness has the best performance.

articleTitle: The Application of an Improved C4.5 Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Decision tree classification method is an effective instance-based learning and data-mining method. In this paper, several decision tree classification algorithms were analyzed, including ID3 and C4.5 algorithm, followed by some improved algorithms. Taylor series and Maclaurin's series are applied to simplify the information gain ratio formula in which way the time efficiency of calculation can be improved. The improved C4.5 algorithm can be applied in the student employment recommendation system. Through this improved C4.5 decision tree algorithm, graduates could have a good guide while seeking for a job and teachers could also help their students in decision-making and job recommendation.

articleTitle: SDN Technology Analysis and Application Research
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This article describes the current development of SDN technology, analyzes the key technologies of SDN network architecture, and summarizes the main application scenarios of SDN. The article introduces the network configuration method based on the SDN network technology, the new network architecture realizes network virtualization, and realize the control and data separation of network equipment through the openflow protocol. SDN technology realizes flexible network control and improves network efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Vo IPQoS Model Combining IntServ and DiffServ Based on Network Processor IXP2400
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By analyzing the mechanism of IntServ (integrated services) and DiffServ (differentiated services), it is pointed out that although IntServ model can provide a QoS (quality of service) guarantee for end-to-end service, there is a limitation in extensibility of the resource reservation process according to RSVP (resource reservation protocol). DiffServ model cannot provide a QoS guarantee for end-to-end service in the whole network, but it can meet requirements of practical application for extensibility. In order to attain the ideal level of the requirements of end-to-end service, a Vo IPQoS model combining IntServ and DiffServ based on network processor IXP2400 is designed by complementing advantages of IntServ mechanism and DiffServ mechanism, and its implementation process is described in detail.

articleTitle: Business Environment Evaluation Based on Entropy-Topsis Model: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A good business environment is a basic element to attract business gathering, release investment potential, improve the credibility and influence of the entire country, and promote economic development. The business environment assessment aimed at sorting out the status quo of the business environment and discovering the weaknesses of the business environment is the prerequisite and basis for optimizing the business environment. This article takes China's 34 provincial capitals, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and single-planned cities as the research objects, sorts out the current business environment indicator system and various research conditions on the system, and builds on this basis to cover the market environment and government environment The evaluation index system of 34 important cities' business environment including eight first-level indicators including legal and policy environment, humanistic environment, human resources, financial services, public services, and innovation environment, and the use of entropy-Topsis model to analyse the data. The research results indicate that in 2017, among the 34 major cities in China, Shanghai, Beijing, and Shenzhen have the best overall business environment in the three first-tier cities, and each city has its own unique advantages.

articleTitle: Semantic Face Completion Based on DCGAN with Dual-Discriminator
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Image completion refers to utilizing image residual information to repair the missing part. In order to solve the problem that the existing models cannot learn the deep features of the image, resulting in inaccurate artifacts in the repaired details, and the inconsistency between the repaired part and the adjacent pixels, we propose a semantic face completion method based on DCGAN with dual discriminator in this paper. We improve DCGAN with dual discriminator to ensure the consistency of local part and global image. In addition, we utilize the VGG16 network to help learn the deep features of the image to make the repaired result clearer and more realistic at the pixel level. Therefore, our method generates images by optimizing the generators with three kinds of loss functions, which are composed of dual image reconstruction loss, dual adversarial loss, and dual image feature reconstruction loss. Experiments on celebA datasets show that the model can get reasonable repairing results, and PSNR and SSIM are higher than baseline on most test datasets.

articleTitle: The De-Obfuscation Method in the Static Detection of Malicious PDF Documents
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Due to its characteristics of rich functionalities, highly integration and platform independent, the Portable Document Format (PDF) format has become the defector standard for the electronic exchange, these characteristics, however, also have given rise to the use of PDF files as a prime vector for malware propagation. As vulnerabilities in the major PDF viewers keep surfacing, effective detection of malicious PDF documents remains an important issue. In this paper, we propose a static method for the detection of JavaScript-bearing malicious documents. Compared to the traditional static detection method, we add the de-obfuscation process in the static analysis, which effectively improved the detection rate. Our evaluation shows that our method has a good performance in the detection of malicious PDF documents, even when they have been extensively obfuscated.

articleTitle: A Secure DHCPv6 System Based on MAC Address Whitelist Authentication and DHCP Fingerprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Secure and controllable address allocation is the primary problem of IPv6 deployment in the campus network. In view of the fact that DHCPv6 protocol itself does not have the function of identity authentication and traditional access authentication methods, such as Portal, S02.1x and L2TP, have high dependence on hardware devices or high requirements for terminal systems, this paper proposes a secure DHCPv6 system in which MAC address whitelist authentication and terminal fingerprint identification are integrated into the address allocation process. Through the system, the clientscan obtain IPv6 addresses and complete access authentication without installing plug-ins or performing complex operations. What's more, the system can effectively prevent MAC spoofing attack. The system has been deployed and validated in the campus network.

articleTitle: Information Security Architecture Design of CBTC System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In existing Communication Based Train Control (CBTC) system, information security threats are analyzed, then information security demands of CBTC system are put forward. To protect information security, three security domains are divided according the Safety Integrity Level (SIL)) of CBTC system. Information security architecture of CBTC system is designed, special use firewalls and intrusion detection system are adopted. Through this CBTC system security are enhanced and operation safety is ensured.

articleTitle: SVR Short-term Traffic Flow Forecasting Model Based on Spatial-Temporal Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of some short-term traffic flow forecasting models that are applied to road intersections, a new short-term traffic flow forecasting model based on support vector regression machine (SVR) with spatial-temporal feature selection is constructed. The model ranks the importance of multi-periods and multi-links features of random forest, and improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the model. Furthermore, by using actual traffic flow dataset at intersection in Nanming district of Guiyang city, the validity and accuracy of the model are verified.

articleTitle: Stacked Auto-Encoder Driven Automatic Feature Extraction for Web-Enabled EEG Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: EEG emotion recognition is able to provide a scientific solution for emotional health assessment. Feature extraction is the fundamental procedure. Traditionally, the future set is generated by the existing theories or rules, which is not convincing and objective enough. Therefore, this paper proposes a data-driven automatic feature extraction methodology for web-enabled EEG emotion recognition based on 2-hidden-layer stacked auto-encoder. Since the web-enabled framework provides large scale of EEG data, emotion-related EEG features can be extracted directly from the time-domain raw wave, which is different from the typical feature extraction methods based on rules and experiences. With the optimal experimental parameters setting, the proposed method extracts typical time-domain distinguishable features from the EEG raw data and obtains relatively low classification error rate. This paper takes a step further towards automatic feature extraction for web-enabled EEG emotion recognition and make the entire framework more impersonal and convincing.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Behaviours Analysis Model for Smart Classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Smart classroom is an intelligent and efficient classroom based on the “Internet +” and the new generation information technologies such as big data and cloud computing. The teaching process of smart classroom contains a large amount of teaching behaviour data with the value of research and application. Based on the review of smart classroom teaching behaviours analysis and evaluation, this paper first compared classical classroom teaching behaviours analysis methods at home and abroad, and then proposed the construction principles and process, and designed the smart classroom teaching behaviours analysis model (SCTBA) to provide research foundation for the analysis and evaluation of teaching behaviours on smart classroom.

articleTitle: A Color Image Encryption Based on 5D Hyper Chaos-Based System and DNA Dynamic Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: An image encryption scheme based on a five-dimensional hyper chaos-based system was proposed and studied. In this scheme, the SHA-256 algorithm was used to generate the initial key of the original image, and the RGB color channels were separated to obtain three two-dimensional matrices. The five-dimensional hyperchaotic system was controlled by the image hash algorithm to generate a five-dimensional random sequence, in which the two related to the index replacement, and the other three concerned the dynamic DNA encoding of the digital image. The NPCR values of each layer of the encrypted image are 99.6120%, 99.6014% and 99.6204% respectively. The UACI values are 33.4845%, 33.4399% and 33.4915%, respectively. Accordingly the information-entropy is 7.9992, 7.9993 and 7.9993 respectively. It is found that the algorithm has a lower correlation between the neighboring pixels, the good security and the strong anti-attack ability.

articleTitle: Web Service Quality Prediction Method Based on Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: For web services, QoS (Quality of Service, quality of service) is an important indicator for judging whether a web service is efficient. How to better predict the QoS value of the service to make appropriate service recommendations is the entire recommendation system and Issues that are being discussed in the service forecasting academia. At the same time, the timeliness and time relevance of QoS values are also affecting the prediction accuracy of Web services. A large amount of QoS data has potentially time-related attributes. This provides a new inspiration and thinking for service forecasting. Add the time characteristics of the data to the learning of the predictive model. Inspired by these factors, this paper proposes a deep neural network combination model that is sensitive to the time characteristics of QoS. At the same time, based on the final experimental results, the model proposed in this paper has obvious effects on the prediction of QoS values with time attributes.

articleTitle: A Cyber Security Risk Assessment Methodology for CBTC Systems Based on Complex Network Theory and Attack Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Cyber security risk assessment is very important to quantify the security level of communication-based train control (CBTC) systems. In this paper, a methodology is proposed to assess the cyber security risk of CBTC systems that integrates complex network theory and attack graph method. On one hand, in order to determine the impact of malicious attacks on train control, we analyze the connectivity of movement authority (MA) paths based on the working state of nodes, the connectivity of edges. On the other hand, attack graph is introduced to quantify the probabilities of potential attacks that combine multiple vulnerabilities in the cyber world of CBTC. Experiments show that our methodology can assess the security risks of CBTC systems and improve the security level after implementing reinforcement schemes.

articleTitle: IOT Monitoring System of Medical Waste Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to realize the “closed-loop management, fixed-point orientation and whole-process traceability” of medical waste, based on face recognition technology and system engineering principle, the IOT monitoring system of medical waste is divided into three levels. Hospital information monitoring center, professional transportation company information monitoring and medical waste treatment company for the first level monitoring information monitoring center, the municipal medical waste management information monitoring center for secondary monitor, provincial medical waste management information monitoring center for three-level monitoring, special is responsible for, layers of management, the framework is clear, break the problem of asymmetric information, personnel and units pursuit problem, easy to study different types of medical wastes output, from different time span to analyze data, data characteristics are studied by using big data, find the abnormal problems, guide the development of the medical enterprise, further to ensure the safety of people's life.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ship-Shore Cooperation for USV: A Brief Survey and Suggested Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) have been widely applied both in military and industrial areas. Intelligent operation and control systems are vital to safe and efficient operations of USVs. This paper provides a comprehensive survey on ship-shore based intelligent operation and control systems. To address the existing issues on perception, computation and control modules, we suggest a corresponding scheme on the multiple subsystems, including the data process, information fusion, operation scenarios analysis, and control system integration. The results may provide some technological support for next generation of intelligent USVs.

articleTitle: AI Quality Cultivation and Application Ability Training for Normal University Students
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The rapid integration of AI technology and education will have a profound impact on the traditional education and teaching ideas, forms, contents, methods, and will also put forward new and higher requirements for teachers' professional quality and teaching ability. For normal university students, AI quality cultivation and application ability training are particularly important. Based on the previous research, this paper holds that digital literacy, computational thinking, programming ability and deep cognition of intelligent society are the important contents of AI technology literacy of normal university students. And put forward that under the AI environment, normal university students' learning ability, teaching ability, teaching research ability three aspects, as well as basic ability, deepening application, application innovation three levels of ability training strategy. And points out that normal university students should learn AI technology and theory in practice, cultivate AI quality and application ability in teaching, and improve human-machine cooperation skills in exploration.

articleTitle: Explore the Performance of Capsule Neural Network Learning Discrete Features
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The continuous breakthrough of deep learning model in image processing, natural language processing and other fields is mainly due to the strong ability of deep neural network in feature extraction. Based on the idea of capsule neural network, this paper proposes a capsule neural network for general classification problems, and explores the learning ability of capsule network model for classification problems of discrete feature. In order to evaluate the capsule network model, this paper verifies the effect of the model on real datasets, and makes a comparative analysis with common machine learning classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Barrage Classification Algorithm for the Protection of Teenager on Video Websites
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to avoid the adverse impact of barrages on teenagers on video website, the author realizes the layering, classification and grading of users' barrages by using the text classification algorithm of deep learning, guides the users' barrages and creates a good ecological environment of network language. The algorithm of barrage classification display needs to be updated in real time. In terms of data, we need to expand the sample of machine learning training in real time, in addition, the classification of language score should be further refined and accurate. In terms of technology, we can combine the latest development of psychology, communication and statistics to make the classification of barrages more accurate.

articleTitle: Analog Circuit Fault Diagnosis Based on FFT-CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To improve the performance of analog circuit fault diagnosis, an ensemble fault diagnosis method combining fast Fourier transform (FFT), convolutional neural network (CNN) and long and short-term memory (LSTM) is proposed. First, FFT is used to convert data to the frequency domain. Then special zone features are obtained by CNN network. Finally LSTM network is used to complete the fault diagnosis of the analog circuit. Experiment on CSTV analog circuit shows that FFT-CNN-LSTM can be used to improve the quality of analog circuit fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Digital Image Soil Analysis based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, a digital image soil analysis model based on machine learning is established.According to the mean value of HSV and image foreground, two algorithms, MLP and SVM, were used to predict the drug content in the same soil, which proved the accuracy of image analysis by MLP network and support vector machine. Drug content detection by image can be applied to land management, which provides a new idea and effective reference for comprehensive soil analysis in many aspects.

articleTitle: A Study of College English Translation Teaching in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: At present, artificial intelligence technology has made a major breakthrough. Big data, cloud computing, language recognition, deep learning and other artificial intelligence technologies are widely used in the field of education and teaching, which not only changes students' traditional learning methods, but also promotes the innovation of teachers' teaching methods and teaching functions. The application of artificial intelligence technology, especially language translation technology in language teaching, has brought new opportunities and challenges for the development of language teaching in colleges. In this paper, artificial intelligence and its development are briefly introduced; then the influence of artificial intelligence on college English translation teaching are analysed; finally, college English translation teaching under the background of artificial intelligence is expounded.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Monitoring System for a Mechanical Equipment Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The equipment management of manufacturing industry has always been the focus of enterprises. A remote monitoring system for mechanical equipment based on Internet of Things is designed to solve the problem. The monitoring terminal is composed of single chip microcomputer and sensors. The status information of the device is collected. The data transmission is based on Modbus RTU protocol. The transmission network is composed of RS-485 and industrial gateway. Then the staff subscribe to the web service of the server. The equipment can be monitored and controlled remotely. Experiments show that the system is stable and reliable. It realizes the information and unified management of the equipment.

articleTitle: CBTC Systems Resilience Evaluation Based on Resource State Model under DoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Communication-based train control (CBTC) systems are threatened by information attacks, which may seriously disturb the operation of trains. In this paper, we propose a method to quantitatively study the resilience of CBTC systems under information attacks. Based on the key features of CBTC systems, a resource state model is proposed to analyze the impact of information attacks on resources. It studies the relation between resources and the operation states of trains, to measure the performance of CBTC systems under different operation states of trains. And it quantifies the resilience of CBTC systems under information attacks. The model uses redundant resources to reflect the resistance of resilience to highlight the fault-tolerance of the system. And the model considers the characteristics of system fail-safe for the first time. Finally, Monte Carlo method is used to simulate a CBTC system under different information attacks scenarios. Simulation results show that our method can effectively evaluate the effect of information attacks on the resilience and find the key weak points of a CBTC system.

articleTitle: Automatic Control System of Sluice Based on PLC, MCGS and MODBUS Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to realize the integrated function of sluice management and control, S7-1200 PLC is used as the master control unit and S7-200 smart is used as the slave control unit. The load, opening degree, water level and other data of the sluice are collected through the special instrument, and the data is transmitted to PLC for storage and processing through MODBUS-RTU protocol. MCGS human-computer interface is designed, and data exchange with PLC through Modbus-TCP protocol is implemented, and the efficiency and intelligence of the sluice operation are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Traffic Signal Control Method Based on A3C Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the growth of national strength, China's infrastructure construction capacity is growing. Traffic signal light is the soul of traffic dispatching, which can improve traffic smoothness and ensure pedestrian safety. The complicated traffic network makes China all-round, but at the same time, it is also more urgent to have more intelligent and efficient dispatching capacity. The conventional traffic signal lights are isolated and static, but traffic is complex and random. Thus, the function of traffic dispatching can be achieved, and the dynamic and intelligent management of traffic can be realized.

articleTitle: Development of a Set of DNA Methylation Markers in the Diagnosis and Prognosis of Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: We tried to develop a prognostic prediction model for PTC patients based on the DNA methylation. Using 571 DNA methylation samples from TCGA database, we built several machine learning models for training then validated with external data to get the best model. Additionally, we constructed a prognostic prediction model that effectively predicted prognosis and survival <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{P} < 0.001)$</tex>. Identified a PTC-specific methylation marker panel by comparing PTC tissue and its adjacent non-tumor tissues using machine learning models, which can distinguish PTC from normal controls with high specificity and sensitivity. The risk coefficient obtained by DNA methylation analysis is more helpful for risk stratification and prognosis prediction in patients with thyroid cancer. The DNA methylation markers could be potentially applied for PTC diagnosis and prognosis.

articleTitle: Relative Analysis of Network Information Security Technology against the Background of “Cloud Computing”
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: “Cloud Computing” serves as the main direction of the development of computer network technology, which is a symbol of the computer technology in a new era. This system is capable of completing the management of massive information and analysis, as a result, it is universally adopted in production and daily life. It also plays an important role in data processing issues, where it can take full advantage of the explosive growth of data, including cloud computing to ensure the security of information on the web and security technologies can be to used to create a more stable online environment. Based on the basic concept of “Cloud Computing”, this paper puts forward the effective measures to prevent network information leakage under the environment of “Cloud Computing” with analysis on its prospect.

articleTitle: Multiple Regression and K-Nearest-Neighbor Based Algorithm for Estimating Missing Values within Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The missing of sensor data is unavoidable when sensors are using to monitor in a system. This missing has very big effecting on the applications of sensor itself. When missing occurred, the best method is to estimate a value as closest as possible to replace it. An algorithm, named KMRA (K-Nearest-Neighbor on Multiple Regression Algorithm), builds on K nearest neighbor and multiple regression is introduced in this paper. In the process of estimation, it considers both spatial correlations from its neighbor sensor and temporal correlations from its own time serials. After computed these two correlations, the algorithm combines them into a unified estimation to be the monitored value. As algorithm KMRA counted both spatial and temporal correlations, it reaches a high efficiency and practicability in performance. The examination results show that KMRA in this paper can estimate the missing data precisely.

articleTitle: Research on Clutter Simulation Method in Navigation Radar Simulator Training System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the course of navigation, the targets echo displayed on the radar simulator often are suffered from clutter interference, and the common clutters includes rain&snow clutter, and wave clutter. In order to make the radar simulator better simulates the real environment, by analyzing the distribution characteristics of rain & snow clutter and sea weave clutter, this paper designs the clutter simulation display method based on Rayleigh distribution and Normal distribution, which can select the distribution characteristics according to the random characteristics of rain &snow clutter, and sea weave clutter, and simulate the real display effect of these two types clutter. The actual results show that the method proposed in this paper can meet the requirements of sea clutter simulation display application for navigation radar simulator.

articleTitle: Research on Ideological and Political Education in Colleges Based on Online and Offline Blended Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Teachers at colleges and universities shall grasp the digital age's young college students' study and living habits and make full use of modern information technology. Through the adoption of online and offline blended teaching methods, teachers shall share moral education teaching resources, assign learning tasks through online learning platform, and release excellent traditional culture and national major principles and policies, the current politics news, advanced deeds, social hot issues, etc. to students, to enrich the ideological education forms and promote the construction of ideological and political education in all aspects.

articleTitle: Motion Detection and Object Detection: Yolo (You Only Look Once)
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Recently, the field of artificial intelligence has seen many advances thanks to deep learning and image processing. It is now possible to recognize images or even find objects inside an image with a standard GPU. Image processing is a recent science that aims to provide specialists from different areas, as to the general public, tools for manipulating these digital data from the real world. The detection of moving objects is a crucial step for systems based on image processing. The movements detected by the classic algorithms are not necessarily interesting for a thorough information search, and the need to distinguish the coherent movements of parasitic movements exists in most cases. In this paper we are going to use a simply webcam and YOLO algorithm for this implementation. The YOLOv3 (Version 3) model makes predictions with a single network evaluation, making this method extremely fast, running in real time with a capable GPU. From there we'll use OpenCV, Python, and deep learning to apply the YOLOv3 object to images and apply YOLOv3 to video streams.

articleTitle: Privacy Crisis in the Age of Artificial Intelligence and its Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the advent of the age of artificial intelligence, the privacy crisis has become a major challenge that people have to face. This paper first analyzes the status quo of artificial intelligence industry. Then by showing the data leakage problems in the current era of artificial intelligence, it analyzes the different hazards brought by the privacy crisis. Finally, this paper puts forward the legal channels and other channels to protect the right of privacy, and introduces the development of these channels.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Rural Tourism Smart Platform Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The further development of tourism cannot be achieved without information technology. The application of information technology can not only improve management efficiency, but also improve service experience, and the shortcomings of rural tourism are just management efficiency and higher quality service experience. The article analyzes the current situation and problems of rural tourism informatization, proposes to build a rural tourism smart platform, and again analyzes the main points and strategies of its construction in order to promote the development of rural tourism informatization and intellectualization.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Cloud Computing Platform Project Based on IaaS and PaaS
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the demand for the use of training rooms in higher vocational colleges is increasing, and the diversified experimental environment is also increasing, This paper aims to meet the increasing demand of training rooms in higher vocational colleges, Build cloud platform based on IaaS and PaaS. It can provide resource sharing for teaching, reasonably allocate training resources, simplify data center management, improve the stability of the platform, business continuity and disaster recovery ability, and better serve students.

articleTitle: Petroleum Software License Usage Forecast Based On ARIMA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In petroleum industry, the expensive software license procurement costs have brought a heavy burden to enterprises. When purchasing the software license, the license management department usually forecasts the reservation, warning, purchase quantity and threshold setting of licenses according to experience and factor analysis method. Due to lack of data support and inaccurate forecast, the enterprises always buy insufficient or surplus quantities of license. In order to solve the above problems, and realize intelligent forecast for license needs, we proposed a method for forecasting the license using status based on ARIMA algorithm, and designed a license management system. Through numerical experiments, it is found that compared with the traditional forecast methods and models, due to the enhanced ability to extract random information, it is more suitable for non-stationary license occupancy sequence forecast in most cases, and the forecast is much more accurate as well.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Opportunity of Ideological and Political Education in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence, as the main driving force of the new scientific and technological revolution, will inevitably bring some threat to the future in the process of upgrading and transformation, but more importantly, the new development opportunities. Ideological and political work has always been the “lifeline” of the work of the Party and the state, and will usher in unprecedented development opportunities in the era of artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence as an information technology can enable ideological and political education in colleges and universities, one is to expand in time, space and situation, that is, to increase free time, expand space, and create a scene of localization to eliminate the dual opposition between the subject and object of ideological and political education and highlight its Noumenon; the other is to create a personalized education with meticulous, accurate and exquisite characteristics; and the third is to use “bit,” man-machine integration”, “Cognitive Outsourcing” realizes the co-construction, co-governance and sharing of ideological and political education resources in colleges and universities; fourth, using big data thinking, deep learning concept and machine learning. The principle of “black box” explores new laws, new ideas and new models of ideological and political education theory.

articleTitle: Employment Situation Analysis of College Students Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In view of the employment problem of college students, the graduate follow-up visit and questionnaire survey were carried out. Considering the study of professional courses and job satisfaction as observation points, we build the employment situation analysis model based on Hidden Markov Model. Applying Viterbi algorithm, our method can find the hidden relationship between students' learning and employment at school and obtain many valuable results, and provides a new way for vocational college students to do their job well.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Imbalanced Fault Diagnosis Method Based on IMWMOTE and MFO-Bayes-LS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In actual industrial production, the historical data of fault diagnosis are often imbalanced. Therefore, this paper uses a fault diagnosis method based on the improved MWMOTE(Majority Weighted Minority Oversampling Technique) algorithm and LS-SVM (Least Squares Support Vector Machines) under the Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) -Bayesian framework. The IMWMOTE algorithm was used to over-sample to obtain the balanced data set. To verify the effectiveness of IMWMOTE algorithm and optimize the parameters of LS-SVM classifier, we used MFO-LS-SVM method to diagnose whether the fault occurred. Then, the Bayesian- LS-SVM method is used to diagnose the fault types. An example of bearing fault diagnosis shows that the proposed method has higher fault diagnosis recognition rate and algorithm robustness than the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Price-based Resource Allocation Scheme for V2X Communications Underlying Uplink Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper investigates price-based resource allocation strategies for V2X communications underlying uplink cellular network, in which vehicular user equipments (VUEs) and cellular user equipments(CUEs) share channel resources. Assuming that base station(BS) protects itself by pricing channel resources for vehicles, we formulate utility functions for BS and VUEs based on Stackelberg game theory. We innovatively proposed broadcast spectrum efficiency and use it as part of the vehicle optimization goal. The Stackelberg equilibriums are characterized. Simulation results show that our pricing method and power selection method are effective in resource allocation and base station protection for V2X communications.

articleTitle: Data Link Fault Location Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As the scale of national grid data continues to grow, data link fault location becomes more and more important. The traditional fault location method has many shortcomings due to its cognitive and technical limitations. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology today, using machine learning technology for data link fault location has become an effective method. Therefore, this paper proposes an autoencoder-BP neural network model, which uses the autoencoder to extract data features, and then uses the BP neural network for classification. Finally, it is proved through experiments that the combination of the two deep learning algorithms can effectively improve Accuracy of fault location.

articleTitle: Integrated Navigation Algorithm for USV with Insufficient Satellites
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: When performing tasks in complex ocean areas, unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) may face partial missing of GPS signals. This paper presents a scheme for the autonomous navigation system of USV in such occasions. In case of insufficient satellites, the loose and tight integrated models of USV navigation system are established with the analysis of error model. The extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm is used for comparative studies on the two integrated models. Simulation results show that the loose combination degenerates into a single inertial navigation system in the insufficient-satellite environments, and the navigation error gradually accumulates with time. In comparison, the tight combination can ensure effective performance in a certain time range with relatively lower position error.

articleTitle: Construction of Diabetes Knowledge Graph Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To integrate medical data which is scattered over the internet, natural language processing (NLP) is widely used in medical text mining. BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is outstanding among many other representation models and vector representation based on Bert pre-training language model can help the target task learn more semantic information. The knowledge graph intuitively reveals the relationship between entities and helps explore deeper semantic connections between entities. There are three important parts in the construction of a knowledge graph, including entity extraction, relation extraction, and graph generation. Based on these methods this paper proposes a Bert-based named entities identification model Bert-BiLSTM-CRF and it is outperforming the established methods. In the relation extraction part, use the BERT-Softmax to improve the semantic expression and its F1-value increased by 12 percent compared with the traditional entity relation extraction model. Based on the above redefined the entities of diabetes and their relationships to enrich the semantics of the knowledge graph. Finally, the Neo4j graph database was used to realize the visualization of the diabetes knowledge map.

articleTitle: Application of Docker Container Technology in University Information Center
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, all sectors of society are gradually inseparable from the application of network system, universities are no exception. They have their own application system in enrollment, teaching, employment, general affairs and other departments, which undoubtedly brings great work pressure to the University Information Center. However, the original application service deployment mode is faced with the problems of low resource utilization, complex management and low implementation efficiency. Combined with the actual situation of colleges and universities, this paper proposes an application service deployment solution based on docker container technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Propagation Path of Tourism Poverty Alleviation based on the Background of “Computer Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: China's fight against poverty has not only greatly promoted the international poverty reduction process, but also effectively enhanced the international image of beautiful China, and tourism poverty alleviation is an important means of poverty alleviation. In recent years, short video app have fully shown its advantages in the new media marketing by the combination of “short video + live”, this combination has also made significant achievements in the field of tourism poverty alleviation. In the crucial key period out of poverty, in order to promote ecological landscape pastoral and Dong culture, network operations team, called “Dong's Seven Fairies”,was set up in Gaibao village in Guizhou province with the help of computer Internet technology. Then the whole village has been out of poverty by computer multimedia, mass communication of short video, live together with goods, electric business operations, such as a new means of communication, and the new path which was different from traditional poverty alleviation by developing industries is opened up. The endogenous power of tourism poverty alleviation is enhanced, and Computer network brand in poverty alleviation was Successful shaped by the means of “computer internet + tourism poverty alleviation” in the computer age of the computer internet.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement Strategy of “Sound Taishan” Tourism Destination Brand Construction Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of society, the competition among tourism destinations is becoming increasingly fierce, and the promotion of their own tourism resources alone is no longer enough to attract consumers. The role of brand is highlighted, and tourism resources and products together form the brand of tourism destinations. Strengthening the construction and enhancement of the brand helps the current deep integration of cultural tourism and the transformation as well as upgrading of tourism. At the same time, with the rapid development of information technology, the traditional tourist tourism is increasingly unable to meet the needs of tourists. The development of information technology and the popularity of mobile devices have made the domestic tourism industry move towards “smart tourism”, and domestic scenic spots have started to vigorously carry out the construction of smart scenic spots. From the perspective of cultural tourism integration, this paper takes brand construction of “Sound Taishan” tourism destination as the research object, selects evaluation indicators based on big data analysis, determines index weights, and conducts comprehensive evaluation of “Safe Taishan” tourism destination brand construction results, in order to provide a reference basis for the evaluation of the brand construction of other regional tourism destinations. According to the evaluation results, the problems of “Sound Taishan” tourism destination brand are identified and the corresponding brand improvement strategies are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on ShadowsocksR Traffic Identification Based on DART Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Shadowsocks (SS) is a new popular anonymous communication software in recent years. The traffic generated by SS is very difficult to identify. There is also an enhanced version of SS, called ShadowsocksR(SSR), which can disguise SS traffic as traditional protocol traffic, such as HTTP traffic, TLS traffic, etc. This makes the identification of SS traffic more difficult. In reference [16], an identification method of HTTP camouflaging traffic of SS is proposed for the first time. Here, a new identification method is proposed based on dart algorithm. Compared with reference [16], this method has more types and wider range of SSR obfuscated traffic, and has better identification effect for recent SSR obfuscated traffic, with the accuracy, the recall and the precision are all above 98.5%.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Performance Evaluation Method for Fuel Cell Commercial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of fuel cell electric vehicles (FCEVs), the number of FCEVs is increasing constantly. In China, the use of commercial vehicles is promoted vigorously. It is necessary to propose a method to evaluate the comprehensive performance of fuel cell commercial vehicles. During the application of cloud data, operation data of electric vehicles can be stored on the cloud to evaluate comprehensive performance. In this paper, a method based on operation data is proposed to evaluate the comprehensive performance of fuel cell commercial vehicles. 5 indicators, including fueling economy, refueling time, driving range, environmental adaptability and reliability, are analyzed and evaluated by the original data. To comprehensively score the performance of vehicles, a weighted score mechanism is proposed. The weights of 5 factors are decided by the analytic hierarchy process. Finally, 2 vehicles are evaluated using the proposed scoring system.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Sea States Images Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Sea state classification plays the important role in maritime safety, management of marine resources, and dynamic monitoring of sea areas. In this study, ResNetl52 model is used for sea states images classification. The data used in this research is the video data provided by the camera installed on the research vessel Dong Fang Hong III of Ocean University of China. The sea states are divided into ten categories according to the driving conditions of the ship and the undulating conditions of the sea. The results show that this method can classify the images of sea states effectively. This method has implications for follow-up studies of sea states, it can provide the basis for classification for the data processing of self-contained optical measuring instruments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Teaching Introduction to Hotel Management in the Context of Smart Hotel
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The rapidly developing information technology has made smart hotels one of the development trends in the hospitality industry. In the transition of pursuing digital transformation of hotel enterprises, artificial intelligence technology is increasingly applied to various fields of hotel services and management. The development of smart hotels and the application of artificial intelligence technology have put forward new demands and standards for hotel professionals. it is necessary to explore the role of artificial intelligence technology in the teaching of relevant courses in hotel management. Combining the construction of the course Introduction to Hotel Management and the analysis of the demand for talents from hotels under the background of the development of smart hotels, this paper explores the application of artificial intelligence technology in teaching Introduction to Hotel Management.

articleTitle: Design and Research on UAV Vibration Resistance Module
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the existing UAV system, the sensor assembly located inside the flight controller, and it will be vibration during flight, resulting in the data deviation of the sensor component within its flight controller. This paper is done by designing a vibration resistance module including a carrier unit for mounting a sensor assembly and a vibration resistance unit connected with the carrier and can buffer the vibration generated to the sensor assembly when the vehicle operates. The vibration resistance unit buffers the vibration caused by the operation of the aircraft, thus improving the data deviation of the angle and acceleration sensor due to the vibration, which is conducive to improving the accuracy of the angle and acceleration sensor detection data.

articleTitle: Research on Pipeline Leakage Detection Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the strong learning ability and arbitrary approximation characteristics of neural network, this paper studies the application of BP neural network in pipeline leakage detection. This paper introduces the structure of BP neural network, determines the experimental scheme and research content, describes the parameters of BP neural network input layer, training target and hidden layer node number in detail, and analyzes the research of leakage location based on BP neural network. The research shows that the neural network method has a wide application prospect for pipeline system fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Improved Tri-Training Based Named Entity Identification Approach for Legal Knowledgebase of Properties Involved in Criminal Cases
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The legal knowledgebase of properties involved in criminal cases aims to automatically complete the knowledge fusion related to the disposal of case-involved properties in criminal cases based on the existing laws and regulations, and provide support to the case handlers of law enforcement and judicial units such as public prosecutors and law enforcement in judicial practice. In this paper, we explore semi-supervised learning based on tri-training for named entity identification of case-related property knowledgebase based on a small amount of annotated data to reduce the workload of corpus annotation. To overcome the problem that the original tri-training method tends to degenerate into a single learner when the amount of training data is small, we propose an improved tri-training method. Experiments show that our proposed method can effectively improve the performance of named entity recognition compared to the traditional tri-training scheme.

articleTitle: Label-Noise Robust Person Re-Identification via Symmetric Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Person re-identification (Re-ID) methods based on deep learning has obtained impressive progress in recent years. And the training of the model usually relies on a large amount of accurate pedestrian identity annotations. However, label noise is unavoidable and has a negative impact on the model training process. But existing research pays little attention to Re-ID with noisy label. In this paper, we propose a label noise robust model for person Re-ID by symmetric learning, without additional clean labels or predefined label distributions. We symmetrically enhance cross-entropy loss through noise robust reverse cross entropy. The experiments demonstrated its effectiveness against various ratios of label noise on the three different benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: A Study on the Ideological and Political Teaching Strategies of French Professional English Course from the Perspective of New Media
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous development of the new media environment in China, more and more media are applied to teaching, and English teaching of French majors also presents a more novel and diversified trend. Integrating Ideological and political education into French professional English teaching with new media teaching methods can not only broaden the knowledge of English classroom and improve the effect of moral education in English classroom, but also expand a new teaching mode and promote the two-way development of English curriculum and ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Modal Analysis and Structure Optimization of Composite Circuit Board
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Vibration has a great effect on electronic components. In this paper, the finite element technology is used to establish a finite element model of a circuit board. By analyzing the vibration characteristics of the circuit board, the installation structure of the circuit board is improved, and the position size of the installation point of the circuit board is optimized, and the optimal structure size of the circuit board is obtained.

articleTitle: The Urban City-Industry Integration Degree Evaluation Based on Ordinal Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The degree of city and industry integration is an important manifestation that a city has the high quality development. A method to evaluate the urban city-industry integration from the perspective of system is put forward in this paper. Firstly, reviewing the relevant researches, the connotation of the urban city-industry integration is clarified, then the urban system is divided into 4 subsystems and the evaluation index system is constructed. By using scientific methods such as coefficient of variation, system coupling and ordinal logistic regression, the coordinated development degree of the urban system and the influence of subsystems on the city-industry integration level are assessed. Finally, through the evaluation model the city-industry integration degree of 21 cities in Guangdong Province is evaluated and some development suggestions are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Policy Text of Maker Space in Zhejiang Province of China
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Maker space is a service platform for innovation and entrepreneurship, and its ultimate goal is to achieve value co creation among multiple subjects. The development and value realization of maker space are closely related to maker space development policy. We use nviov to make a qualitative analysis of 30 Zhejiang Province maker space development policies. Through the sample selection, word frequency statistical analysis and coding analysis, seven core areas are summarized: financial support, policy support, talent introduction, environmental construction, science and technology promotion, mass innovation space and service effectiveness. Based on the theory of innovation elements, this paper constructs and interprets the model of the development elements of maker space, and finally puts forward policy suggestions for maker space development.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism and Task Allocation Methods for Mobile Crowd Sensing: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Mobile crowd sensing (MCS) is a computing paradigm that recruits citizens to collect and contribute sensing data from surroundings using their smart device. The incentive mechanisms and task allocation methods are critical parts that affect whether the MSC campaigns could continue gaining sensing data. In this paper, we survey the literature over the period of 2018–2020 from the state-of-the-art of incentive mechanism and task allocation method design in MCS.

articleTitle: Research on the Reform of Teaching Mode in Higher Education Institutions Based on Internet Thinking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology in the world today has brought earth-shaking changes to people's daily life, and has also promoted the reform of the traditional teaching mode of colleges and universities. In order to adapt to the rapid development of the times, teaching under the Internet thinking Reform is imminent. This article systematically studies the teaching reform of colleges and universities through the use of user thinking, concise thinking, extreme thinking, iterative thinking, flow thinking, social thinking, big data thinking, and platform thinking in Internet thinking. Use value of teaching reform results.

articleTitle: Research on the Fine Management Platform of Scientific Research Activities under the Information Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: How to realize fine management of scientific research activities in the in-formation age. Scientific research activities staff urgently needs to solve this practical problem. Based on the cur-rent situation of scientific research activities in universities, this paper puts forward the overall requirements for comprehensive and fine management of scientific research activities, and expounds the specific content and module design. We should further promote the reform of the management system, and strive to strengthen the information construction of scientific research activities center by means of modernization and informatization. By means of precise management, we will improve the contribution of scientific research activities to the information construction and teaching environment of colleges. We will comprehensively improve the quality and efficiency of the use of resources.

articleTitle: The Effects of Government Innovation Investment on the Development of Computer Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The transformation of economic model from investment-led development to innovation-led development indirectly reflects the will of high-quality development goals. As an economically strong province in China, Guangdong stands at the foremost position of reforms. This paper examines the effectiveness of government innovation investment on the industrial agglomeration in manufacture of computer industry (computer, communication and other electronic equipment) and high-quality economic development in Guangdong. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) Government innovation investment has a significant positive impact on the industry development. The positive effect of the industrial agglomeration on economic growth needs to be interposed by government innovation investment, but there is no impact on technological progress. (2) we found that government innovation investment and industry agglomeration have a direct and significant positive impact on economic growth, while only government innovation investment promotes technological progress. This shows that there is an inefficiency problem in the industrial agglomeration, and increasing government innovation investment is conducive to promoting technological progress.

articleTitle: Integrated Navigation Algorithm for Intelligent USVs with Unstable GPS
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In complex marine or unpredictable combat environments, there may be unstable and even loss of GPS for the integrated navigation system of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). This paper analyzes the error model of loose combination navigation, and proposes a method of the recurrent neural network (RNN) aided inertial navigation system (INS). When the GPS signal is interrupted, the RNN is used to correct the navigation error of the INS. Simulation results show that in case of unstable GPS, the RNN-aided navigation system can ensure rapid convergence of error, and the east position error can be kept within a satisfactory scope. Compared with the single inertial navigation system, the navigation accuracy is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Label Interpolation Based Deep Learning for Direction of Arrival Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, an end-to-end framework is proposed for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation on the conditions of anechoic and low SNR environments via Deep Learning (DL). Spectrum labels generated by interpolation methods are used for regressors attainment in the training of neural networks. When the regressors converge properly, a peak finding strategy is proposed to estimate DOAs more precisely, which consists of the Gaussian smoothing, rough sampling and Least Squares method. Numerical experiments prove that this framework performs better than the existing DL methods.

articleTitle: New Development of Family Education in China and America with Ubiquitous on-Line Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Family education plays an important role both in past and future. Nowadays, Ubiquitous on-line learning is widely adopted around the world especially during outbreak of Covid-19 epidemic period. Due to various reasons including historical background, culture and life styles, the family education between Chinese and America is different. In China, on the one hand, some parents extremely attach care for their child's family education. On the other hand, the problem of left behind children is so general in China. For left behind children, the separation from parents will affect their growth lacking of guidance and good family education. With an attempt to appeal more Chinese parents to attach importance to the family education, especially for left behind children by stating the importance of family education with the assistance of ubiquitous on-line learning.

articleTitle: The Research On Evaluation of Textile Enterprise Environmental Governance Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent years, textile industry has encountered environmental problems such as atmospheric dust pollution, illegal discharge of pollutants, and accumulation of solid pollutants. However, how to evaluate the environmental governance efficiency of textile enterprises has become a problem. In this paper, we establish a evaluation system for the environmental governance performance evaluation of textile companies and give some suggestions, so that the enterprise can be more friendly to environment with highly development.

articleTitle: Research on Source Monitoring System of Medical Waste Recycling Smart Device
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Medical waste is more harmful to the environment than ordinary household. In order to closely monitor the recovery of medical waste from the source, this article provides a source monitoring system for a medical waste recycling smart device. This method can solve the problem of the generally low level of intelligence, monitoring strength and source information digitization of medical waste collection devices, which is helpful to realize efficient classified collection and strict monitoring of medical waste from the source of production, and the system is sensitive and safe. The coefficient is high, and the perfect combination of software and hardware is achieved as a whole, which is conducive to large-scale production and promotion.

articleTitle: The Teaching Research on Satellite Sub-Satellite Point Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The knowledge of satellite Sub-Satellite point is the basis of many courses, such as: satellite launching, Manned space flight, satellite communication, Spacecraft System, and so on. It analyzes the effects of Sub-Satellite point in the course of Satellite Communication. It analyzes the Sub-Satellite point from different aspects. According to different characteristics, it uses many different teaching methods. It can enhance the positivity with animation demonstration, STK simulation software and actual task instances. With the different methods in teaching, the students can study the theory knowledge better and grasp the knowledge better.

articleTitle: Research on the Targeted Poverty Alleviation Path of Red Tourism Commodities in Shandong from the Perspective of “Internet + Agriculture”
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Considering that red tourism commodity is an important booster for targeted poverty alleviation, this study is centered on targeted poverty alleviation with red tourism commodity to put forward the main paths for targeted poverty alleviation, such as “unified government planning, integration of Internet and agriculture, richening people with red tourism commodity” from the perspective of “Internet + agriculture”, and summarize the development strategy of red tourism commodity based on “Internet +”, thereby providing reference for other areas in promoting the targeted poverty alleviation by virtue of red tourism.

articleTitle: Profiling Pumped Storage Power Station via Multi-Sequence Joint Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Suggesting personalized tags to the Pumped storage hydropower plants (PSHPs) towards purchase requirements forecasting plays a key role in achieving the smart power grids. However, current tag suggestion solutions only take single sequence into consideration, and predict single label for PSHPs, resulting in suboptimal forecasting accuracy. In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-Sequence Joint Regression (MSJR) model towards the task of PSHP tagging. In particular, MSJR exploits multi-sequence as input for collaborative perception purpose, and a multi-label regression module is built in the MSJR framework to predict tags describing the purchase requirements of PSHPs. Our encouraging experimental results on a real-world dataset, crawled from the ERP system of the State Grid Xin Yuan, validate the superiority of the our MSJR over several existing tagging suggestion methods.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Comprehensive Decision Support System in the Lower Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The lower Yellow River has been restricted by many factors such as nature, economy, society and environment for a long time. It is a complex and arduous task to manage the channel and beach area of the lower Yellow River. The comprehensive decision support system provides a good way to solve the above problems. In this paper, the architecture of the system is studied to improve the versatility and portability. Secondly, GIS, network communication and database technology are used to integrate hydrological model, hydrodynamic model, sediment transport model, optimal operation of reservoir group, functional planning of beach area and virtual reality technology. The system, model and hydrological data are closely integrated to build the decision support system of the lower Yellow River. The system provides technical support and application platform for river channel and beach area treatment in the lower Yellow River.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation Method of LDPC Efficient Decoding Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper,the logarithmic domain efficient decoding algorithm of LDPC code has been deeply studied,and the efficient algorithm with tree topology structure has been improved. The fixed-point representation and reweighting analysis of the receiving and processing information of LDPC code decoding has been carried out. At the same time,based on Quartus development software platform and Verilog HDL language,the efficient parallel decoding algorithm of regular LDPC code with length of 8designed by geometric construction method is designed, and the circuit design and simulation results of some main modules are given. The logic synthesis and implementation of the whole algorithm are carried out on StatixL EP2S60F484C3.The highest data processing rate is 10Mbps,and the error correction performance is ideal. After the reprocessing method is adopted,all the information in the decoding implementation process is the same standard,and there is no need for additional processing , which reduces the hardware complexity and calculation delay,and meets the needs of engineering implementation.

articleTitle: Emotional Analysis and Application of Leisure Space Based on Digital Design
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Digital Space Emotion Design is a new exploration of space possibilities. The Digital Space Design, as a warm shelter, is a place for people to feel happy, relax and stay for a long time. This paper focuses on the mutually beneficial and dynamic relationship between human and pet, and takes the Digital design of pet cafe as a carrier to design the space to increase the experience between people and space. Based on the differences between humans and cats in the same time and space, the author of this paper changes the perspective and attitude of cats to feel the space, takes the perspective shift between human and animal as the concept, investigates and studies the internal structure and configuration of different pet theme stores, and then designs the pet space in the form of cave, bringing people the thinking of the harmonious coexistence of human and animal and different space emotional experience.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Communication Method for Smart Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Real-time data communication plays an essential role in smart coal-fired power plants for optimization control and timely alarm. However, the previous methods mainly use UDP broadcast, which results in a lot of redundant data and inability to meet the requirement of smarter optimization. In this paper, we propose a real-time data communication method based on the publish/subscribe mechanism. The server accurately and promptly distributes the data to upper computers according to their subscription information. Furthermore, we present a load-based adaptive data distribution policy. The server directly distributes data to all subscribers when it works in low load. But when the server is in high load, a complete binary distribution tree is constructed among the subscribers and the server acts as the root. Then the intermediate subscribers in the distribution tree will forward data to their children. The experimental results show that our method is superior to the previous methods and can reduce the data transmission delay significantly.
