articleTitle: Impact of the Pandemic on Information and E-Commerce Stock Market Returns: The Case of Hong Kong
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The impact of COVID-19 on the fluctuations of stock markets has been dramatic, causing great volatilities. This article tries to measure this impact in the context of Hong Kong stock returns of particular sectors like information, E-commerce and so on. The article expands the previous panel regression researches on short-term effect of COVID-19 confirmed and death cases growths, by extending the research horizon to the most recent date and applying panel model to each unique stock sector and comparing their results altogether, including 1,815 firms, 216 days and 319,251 samples. In the findings, it turns out that the information and E-commerce industries (140 firms in total) are significantly negatively affected by the growth of daily COVID confirmed cases, and that the Hausman tests support the fixed effect model. After that, recommendations are formulated to help stakeholders of various types hedge financial risks and maintain the financial system at this critical moment.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Checked-baggage Departed from Airport Terminal Based on Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Checking baggage for passengers is an important part of the check-in process, which efficiency directly affects the duration when passengers stay in the airport. Predicting the amount of baggage and allocating human resources rationally can help improve the efficiency of airport operations. The amount distribution characteristics of the checked-baggage demand is analyzed based on the actual operating data of the airport in this study. A long-term prediction model based on the multiplicative seasonal model (SARIMA) is built to predict the baggage amount. Results show that the SARIMA model can describe the characteristics of time series, which has high prediction accuracy and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Existence of Mild Solutions for Semi-Linear Measure Driven Equations With Infinite Delay
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper we prove the existence of mild solutions for semi-linear measure driven equations with infinite delay in Banach spaces. We first establish some conclusions about measure of noncompactness and the phase space of axiomatic system. Then we obtain some existence results by using the fixed point theorem. Some restrictive conditions on a priori estimation and compact semigroup are avoided. The results obtained here improve and generalize many know results. An example is given to illustrate our main results.

articleTitle: Study on Failure Law of Deformation and Instability of Surrounding Rock in Deep Soft Rock Roadway
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large deformation and soft fracture of soft rock in deep roadway, through theoretical analysis of deformation and failure characteristics of surrounding rock of deep roadway, the space-time evolution law of deformation and failure of surrounding rock of deep soft rock roadway is obtained by FLAC3D software simulation. The results show that: The deformation of surrounding rock in deep soft rock roadway is characterized by roof subsidence, two sides moving inward and floor bulging. Under the action of high stress, the deformation of surrounding rock of soft rock roadway has a certain timeliness. The deformation and failure of surrounding rock of roadway is a changing process with time. The damage degree of roof, floor and two sides of roadway increases with time, and finally tends to a stable state. The deformation presents a distribution law that the de-formation of floor is larger than that of roof and convergence of two sides.

articleTitle: A Novel Design Scheme for an Ejection Device Inspection Instrument
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Inspecting an ejection device of an aircraft has been a long-standing problem due to technical, safety and cost restraints. A novel inspection instrument was designed to meet this need using low-pressure cold gas instead of the high-pressure gas. Dynamic simulation and analysis were carried out to approximate nominal parameters and MCU+CPLD design was used to increase the clock division option of the system to adapt to different ejection velocities to reduce errors. Application feedback from the fields shows that the instrument is easy to operate and reliable, and can check the performance of many types of ejection device, which will improve reliability and accuracy of releasing, the level of protection for the ejection device and effectively guarantee flight safety and the completion of training tasks.

articleTitle: Adaptation Level Evaluation of Two Free Online Machine Translators Youdao and Google in Translating Chinese City Publicity Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Globalization and the opening up lead to an increasing demand for the translation of publicity materials to let the world know more about China. This paper aims to probe the Chinese-English translation of city publicity materials from the perspective of Verschueren's Linguistic Adaptation Theory by using two online translators of Youdao and Google. Translation is a process of transforming information in one language into another one. English and Chinese belong to different families with different characteristics in words meaning, syntax structure and cultural background. The study aims to see whether these two online translators can make flexible and necessary adaptations to gap the differences between these two languages. The findings of this study imply that these machine applications can be implemented to perform Chinese into English translation to get the broad gist of a source text, but could not make most of the necessary and sufficient adaptations on linguistic and non-linguistic levels, so deep and thorough post-editing process is essential. The study recommends that more studies are encouraged to continue to assess the quality of machine translation, with the maim of further highlighting its weaknesses and finding out the strategies that should be adopted to overcome them.

articleTitle: The Impact of “11.11 Shopping Festival” on E-Commerce and Traditional Industries
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the positive and negative effects of “double 11” on e-commerce and traditional industries. It also analyzes the origin and formation of “double 11” e-commerce, including people's views on traditional industries and e-commerce and the change of marketing concept.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Security Mechanism of Mobile Payment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Mobile payment has become the mainstream payment method in daily life, such as low cost and convenient portability. Now that mobile payment is so popular, the security issues behind it should also be paid attention to. Therefore, this article will discuss the security risks of mobile payments and analyze the security risks of mobile payments based on the current payment security risks faced by mobile payments. Technical framework, discuss its mobile payment security protection technical measures.

articleTitle: Conception of Building EWIS Data Integration Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As an independent comprehensive system, Electrical Wiring Interconnection System (EWIS) has the characteristics of high degree of integration, complex installation environment, many components selection, huge system data and fast technology refresh and iteration. According to the distinguishing feature of EWIS development, this platform uses Dreamweaver to make the basic framework and modify the page, Apache + PHP + MySQL software architecture to build a dynamic website operation platform, build a life cycle EWIS data integration management platform with friendly visual interface, and integrate the design data such as input, scheme, design process data, design documents and design drawings in the EWIS design process, At the same time, we design a multi person collaborative data transfer module to realize the continuity and iteration of EWIS data.

articleTitle: Research on Process Optimization of Policy Food Information Management Based on ESIA Method
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The policy food plays an important role in China's food system. The information management of policy food needs to continuously optimize the existing processes to ensure that the management of the food department is in a high-efficiency state. The ESIA method is used as a tool and method of process reengineering theory. Its main purpose is to improve information management efficiency and reduce management costs by reengineering and optimizing the original process. Aiming at a series of problems such as inaccurate data and long information collection period in the policy food information management, this article uses the ESIA method to optimize the management process.

articleTitle: The Comparison in Polite Language between Western Culture and Chinese Culture
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: First, different cultural backgrounds of China and western countries are introduced in this paper. Then, the cultural differences between Chinese and English in the use of polite language are illustrated through the examples, including the differences of salutation, greetings, appreciation language, praise language, taboo language and other polite language. Finally, we summarize the various differences between Chinese and Western culture in the use of polite language, so we can eliminate the cultural interference, avoid the cultural conflict, seek common ground while reserving differences and create a good communicative atmosphere to promote the cross-cultural communication.

articleTitle: Practical Research on Computer Aided Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In today's information age of big data, the amount of translation is growing rapidly, and the traditional manual translation can not meet the needs of this large number of translation. With the development of science and technology, the emergence of computer-aided translation technology is just an effective solution to this problem. The scientific and reasonable application of computer-aided translation technology in the process of translation practice can greatly improve the efficiency of translation, ensure the quality of translation, and obtain the expected translation effect.

articleTitle: Zero Watermarking Algorithm in Wavelet Domain Based on Chaotic Scrambling
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Zero-watermark is the data information constructed by extracting a certain amount of eigenvalues from the original carrier image. In order to achieve effective copyright authentication, feature value and copyright information are calculated together to generate zero-watermarking. It is very important to extract the feature information of carrier image. Considering the efficiency and stability of the security and concealment, we redesign the zero-watermark extraction algorithm. The security and concealment of zero watermarking can be improved by using chaotic encryption for both image and water copyright image. Extracting feature information from low frequency region of wavelet can make zero-watermark have good stability. Singular value decomposition (SVD) is used to extract the maximum singular value of the sub block in the low frequency region of the wavelet, and the feature information is extracted to construct the zero watermarking. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is effective in extracting zero-watermark information.

articleTitle: A Question Answering System Based on Multi-Granularity Semantic Interaction Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To solve the problem that existing machine reading comprehension system can't understand and interact with the semantics of articles and questions, this paper proposes a multi-granularity semantic interaction neural network model. The model introduces granular attention interaction and self-attention interaction mechanism to multi-granularity semantic representation model. Experiments on the SQuAD dataset prove that our proposed model is superior to traditional models in terms of exact match rate and F1 value. In conclusion, the model's performance is improved by multi-granularity semantic understanding, reasoning and interaction.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Method Reform of Automobile Related Courses: Take the Vehicle Hydraulic System as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology and economy, automobile has almost become the necessities of our life, and the automobile industry has been growing. However, there is a shortage of automobile talents in the society, so the school's teaching of automobile specialty is particularly important. This paper analyzes the shortcomings of the traditional Chinese teaching mode, and then explains the deficiencies of automobile related professional courses. In view of this, this paper expounds the effective measures that can be taken by the automobile related professional courses. This paper designs a new teaching method which can make full use of all kinds of teaching aids, at the same time, it can help to improve the teaching method by the combination of teaching and discussion, and the combination of theory and practice. It is applied to the classroom teaching of vehicle hydraulic system and device. This kind of teaching method improves students' interest in learning, stimulates students' creativity, strengthens the teaching link of disassembling and assembling experiment of students' on-site vehicle hydraulic system, which can greatly improve students' professional skills.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Ultrasonic Fatigue Specimen Based on ANSYS Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The design method of ultrasonic fatigue specimen is briefly described, and the size of dog-bone shaped specimen is preliminarily designed by analytical method, which provides reference size for specimen design. Modal analysis and harmonious response analysis of the solid model are carried out by ANSYS software, and the natural frequency of aluminum alloy dog-bone specimen is obtained. By controlling a single variable, the natural frequencies of specimens with different sizes are solved respectively, and the influence of resonance length on the natural frequencies of specimens is obtained. According to this rule, the size of the specimen is optimized, so that the natural frequency of the specimen can reach 20000Hz.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Visual Simulation Software for WSNs Communication Link
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the distribution model and communication protocol structure of WSNs communication mechanism, considering the real-time communication processing and human-computer interaction of Wireless sensor network, a visual simulation software for WSNs communication link based on <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{MATLAB}/\mathbf{VC++}$</tex> has been designed, this simulation software has mainly designed the function, user interface and software flowcharts. The test results show that the software has strong real-time and human-computer interaction, and can provide technical support and reference for the optimization of communication link in WSNs through the configuration of different modes and parameters.

articleTitle: Block Chain + Accounting: Applications, Challenges and Countermeasures Research
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Block chain is a new application model integrating distributed data storage, peer-to-peer transmission, consensus mechanism, encryption algorithm and other computer technologies born under the background of rapid development of the Internet, and its emergence has aroused the attention of various countries and discussions in various industries. The application of blockchain technology to the accounting field has been a hot topic of research and exploration for scholars in recent years. Its features of decentralization, de-trust, immutability, data traceability and smart contracts can solve the trust problem faced by the accounting field. The article focuses on the nature, working principle and characteristics of blockchain, discusses the advantages of applying blockchain to accounting, and proposes some problems faced by “block chain + accounting” today as well as strategies to solve the problems.

articleTitle: A Research on Network Resources and Task-Based Instruction for Chinese College English Learners
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the computer technology and the massive application of network resources, we have stepped into a new era of education, in which modern technologies have been comprehensively used. There are a large number of good network resources available on the internet; and provided much more opportunities and accesses to the English language learners. The aim of this study is to investigate the effects of task-based instruction on Chinese college English learners by using network resource in the process of teaching. The author tries to provide some thoughts and methods on integrating network resources to task-based English teaching. It is hoped to be beneficial for English teachers to increase the efficiency of teaching in practice.

articleTitle: Service Innovation for Value Co-Creation: The Role of Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The question of how digital technology (DT) can be used to trigger new service innovations for value co-creation remains an uninvestigated question in traditional manufacturing industry. In this paper, we found an important way to achieve the new service innovation is through building and utilizing a digital service platform, which helps firms to liquefy digital resource and enhance resource density among various actors. Based on an in-depth case study of a Chinese garment firm, we present a service innovation for value co-creation model and emphasize the role of DT-both as an operand resource and as an operant resource in the service innovation process. The model highlights the bundling of diverse resources to create the novel resources that are mutually beneficial for both customers and firms. Our study contributes to the literature by investigating the operant role of DT and extend the emergent nature of service innovation in the garment industry.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Method of the Train Occupancy Rate Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The train occupancy rate is an important indicator to measure the performance of the high-speed railway(HSR) operation plan. It reflects the matching degree of the supply and demand of the passenger transport. To improve the service level of the passenger transportation, the use of rich train operation data and machine learning(ML) algorithms to mine the relevant laws of HSR passenger transportation has become a significant research topic. Therefore, the purpose of this article is to explore the predictive accuracy of the ML algorithm and to explore whether the combined model of ML can further improve the accuracy. Based on the data of a certain high-speed rail, this paper focuses on the feature construction method of the departure date and its type, and at the same time, using multiple linear regression, ML algorithms (SVR, KNN, RFR, DTR), and their combination to establish a prediction model. Experimental results show that the use of train schedule data, ML algorithms, and their combination can significantly improve the predictive accuracy of the train occupancy rate.

articleTitle: Imaging Multivariate Time-Series to Improve Fault Detection: Application on Tennessee Eastman Process
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The correlation between sequences of multivariate time series has been ignored by many researchers, which is one of the most important attributes and will benefit the improvement of classification accuracy. The chief content of this study is to analyse the performance of correlation to classify MTS, and then apply it to the fault detection of Tennessee Eastman (TE) process. Generally, a novel method for encoding MTS as 2D images, namely, PCC-MGAF is proposed and then a conventional CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) model is used for classification. The data is rearranged based on PCC (Pearson correlation coefficient) and then an improved GAF (Gram Angular Summation) method is proposed to extract expanded features before being inputted into CNN. The experiment shows the approach proposed in this study achieves highly competitive results when compared to three of other classification methods. Besides, the performance of this study reaches a new level while detecting some minor faults which are difficult to distinguish.

articleTitle: Research on Public Sentiment of Weibo Topics Based on Emotional Tendency-Taking “LaBiXiaoQiu Was Detained” as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the booming development of social media, many people use social software to share their life experiences and express their opinions, viewpoints and experiences on social hot spots, thus forming a huge amount of information. This paper takes microblog topic comments as the research object and makes visual analysis of microblog comments from the perspective of emotional orientation, which is of great research significance for relevant departments to timely grasp the changes in the masses' thoughts and timely control and deal with emergencies. In this study, the Bert-LSTM model was used for sentiment classification of microblog comments, and the complex and sparse data sets were visualized to convert the disordered data signals into graphic representations. Through in-depth emotional mining of public opinion comments, the importance and effectiveness of online public opinion analysis in the era of data explosion are verified.

articleTitle: Landmark Selection Based on Similarity Measure of Vague Soft Sets Considering User Preferences
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As a kind of route clue, landmark is very important because it can convey a kind of enlightening hint when people make route choice. Pedestrians' cognition of landmarks is related to themselves, and the existing landmark selection methods do not consider user preferences. To solve this problem, considering setting topic parameters to represent user preferences for each landmark significance influencing factor, this paper constructs a landmark selection model based on similarity measure of Vague soft sets with user preferences, which the topic weights normalized by the topic parameters are integrated into the similarity measure equation of Vague soft sets, and the similarity measures to select landmarks are calculated by comparing with the ideal solutions. Compared with the existing methods, the landmarks selected by the method of this paper are more in line with the user cognition and more effective to prompt the user to choose the route.

articleTitle: App Evaluation Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper proposes an App evaluation and analysis method based on machine learning algorithm for the problem of App evaluation without distinguishing categories. Firstly, the random forest model is used to predict App evaluation and detect the importance of sample attributes. Then combined with statistical methods, the word cloud map is used for further analysis and verification. Finally, characteristics of App products and users from multiple perspectives were analyzed, providing guidance and suggestions for App developers' future product development and users' reasonable choice of products, which effectively promotes the good development of commercial App market.

articleTitle: Design of EAST-NBI Field Control System Based on Profibus-DP Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The EAST-NBI system is composed of vacuum, power supply, water cooling and other subsystems distributed in different physical locations. Due to the system composition is very complex, there are system integration challenges that need to be solved for on-site control. By adopting the PLC system with Siemens Profibus-DP protocol, the graphical process control of field equipment is developed, which solves the problems of excessive wiring in the system integration of complex control systems and interlocking control of distributed systems, and realizes high-speed data communication between system monitoring, system interlocking and other control functions. The experimental results show that the on-site control system reliably completes the EAST-NBI control task.

articleTitle: CycHash: A Novel Deep Learning to Hash Method for Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: We propose a deep learning to hash method named CycHash to improve image retrieval. Its network is an encoder-decoder architecture. Cooperated with full-connected layers, an encoder is used to transform image to hash code. The decoder network is used to restore high-dimensional data from encoded feature maps. We define a restoration loss between the restored data from decoder network and inputted data of decoder network. The restoration loss and central similarity loss are summarized to guide the learning of hash function. Experiments of image retrieval demonstrate the effectiveness of our CycHash method and CycHash outperforms state-of-the-arts.

articleTitle: A Research on the Perception of Authenticity of Self-service Tourists Based on the Background of Smart Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent years, the promotion of smart tourism has not only improved the level of information technology in tourist destinations, but also brought various conveniences to self-service tourists to a certain extent. However, the improvement of self-service tourists' satisfaction with the tourist destination experience has not been obvious. This article analyzes the influencing factors between self-service tourists' satisfaction with the authenticity of tourist destinations and the data information of smart tourism platforms from the perspective of tourist perception in the development of big data modernization. It is found that first, the incomplete information on the smart tourism platform reduces the authenticity of experience of self-service tourists; second, the lack of innovation in smart tourism information platforms affects the authenticity of tourist destinations; last, there is a conflict between the limitations of cultural resources and the perception of the perception of authenticity, and so on. The satisfaction of college students majoring in tourism from the place of origin and the local perception provides suggestions for the development of smart tourism, and is expected to play a corresponding guiding role in the development of tourist destinations. Therefore, it is proposed to provide sustainable and thorough suggestions for the development of smart tourism by utilizing the perception of satisfaction of tourism major students and residents from the local region, which can be expected that it can play a corresponding guiding role for the development of tourism destinations.

articleTitle: Research on Time Domain Filtering Based on Choi-Williams Distribution about Time-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the non-stationary characteristics of the time-phase modulation signal, in this paper, Choi-Williams distribution time-domain filter method is put forward to solve the problem that the bad aggregation performance of time-domain analysis and poor detection performance of the system in the time-phase modulation signal analysis. First the best input parameter of the time-phase modulation signal is determined by the analyses of cyclo-stationarity and power spectral characteristics and the effect of the phase transition time, transition angle and other parameters on the power spectrum. Second the Choi-Williams transform method is used to get the relationship between the Choi-Williams time-frequency distribution and the phase mutation angle, the window function length, the carrier frequency and other parameters. Theoretical analysis and simulations show that: the time domain filtering based on Choi-Williams time-frequency distribution can convert the phase mutation characteristics of time-phase modulation signal into amplitude information by which we can detect TPM signal. The performance comparison is simulated between the detection method of this paper and the traditional filtering method, and the error rate of method in this paper is 1–2 dB lower than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Development of AR Technology and Rural Red Research Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: AR technology superimposes computer-generated virtual worlds on the real world, which redefines the coexistence mode of physical space and Internet, and has a broad application prospect. In this paper, the practical application of AR technology in research tourism through a case is introduced and the necessity and advantages of integrating AR technology into rural red research tourism are discussed and analysed. Finally, two ways of integrating AR technology into rural red research are proposed, namely, reappearing historical scenes and activating historical buildings.

articleTitle: Question Answering System Model Based on Multi Granularity Semantic Representation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of polysemy and overflow words in traditional vector representation methods such as word2vec and glove in question answering system, this paper introduces Elmo language model, char-CNN and traditional natural language features, and makes a complete semantic representation of the original corpus text from multiple language granularity levels A neural network model for multi granularity semantic representation. Experiments on the squad dataset show that the proposed model is superior to the classical bidaf model in terms of accurate matching rate and F1 value.

articleTitle: The Fuel Gas Odorizing Equipment Based on Siemens LOGO!
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper introduces a fuel gas odorizing equipment based on Siemens LOGO!. The odorizing equipment is mainly composed of detector, Siemens LOGO!, the actuator and the gas leak alarm system. This equipment is an overall controlling and monitoring system for the process of gas odorizing. In the design, the automatic control and monitoring system is composed of the upper computer and Siemens LOGO! according to the actual working conditions of different projects. Using Siemens LOGO! as the main component of hardware equipment, we have designed the hardware structure and the software program of data collection, action execution and interrupt.

articleTitle: A New Method of Property Right Transaction of Service Data Resources Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As a new business format, data resource transaction breaks the current situation of information fragmentation of government and enterprises, and it has become the consensus of academic circles and business circles to manage and utilize data as assets. At present, the market and mode of data resource transaction are still immature, and there are some problems such as difficult data resource integration, pricing and transaction supervision, which restrict the further development of data resource transaction. In the whole transaction chain of data resources, there are still severe challenges of “four difficulties” of transaction system and “three noes” of transaction service. How to break through the “last mile” of the whole transaction chain has become the focus of social attention. In this paper, a new method and technical scheme of property right transaction of service data resources based on blockchain is proposed and implemented systematically, which proves that the scheme is feasible, easy to implement, and has the advantages of high scalability and security.

articleTitle: Application of Image Segmentation Based on Deep Learning in Mobile Terminal Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Currently, ultrasound image segmentation on mobile terminal has two limitations. First, the images collected by portable ultrasonic devices are of low quality and poor quality, which makes it difficult for traditional digital image processing methods to segment the target region accurately and stably. Second, the limited resources of mobile terminals make it difficult for deep learning models to operate efficiently on mobile terminals. Therefore, this paper improves the image segmentation model and applies it to portable ultrasonic equipment after compression. Firstly, the MobileNet V2 structure was used to replace the deep network of feature extraction in the Deeplabv3 + network model, so as to make it lightweight and reduce the parameters and calculation amount. Then, the model after training was quantified and compressed. Finally, the compressed model was applied to the neck artery image segmentation in portable ultrasound equipment. The direction of blood vessel and the Angle of line deflection are calculated from the segmenting images, and the automatic adjustment of color Doppler sampling frame is realized by using the parameters. Experimental results show that the improved deep learning model can accurately and quickly segment blood vessels on mobile devices.

articleTitle: Corpus-Based Statistical Analysis of TEM-4 Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: TEM-4 reading comprehension is one of the key and difficult points to the students. This paper creates the small corpus based on TEM-4 reading comprehension during 2009 to 2019 and then adopts corpus analytic software to make statistical analysis from the textual, lexical and syntactic aspects in order to provide some reference in reading teaching and preparing for the exam.

articleTitle: UIAE: Collaborative Filtering for User and Item based on Auto-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: These years, deep learning achieves huge success on recommender systems. Collaborative filtering using past interaction information is the primary method for recommender system. Although some recent works employ deep learning for collaborative filtering, they only consider one dimension of interaction information. We present a new model called collaborative filtering for users and items based on Auto-Encoder (UIAE). It learns interaction information from two dimensions. UIAE is a union of User-based and Item-based collaborative filtering that gets better performance than each of them. Experiments on two data sets are made researching the impacts of different components of UIAE and comparison experiments with previous CF methods based on Auto-Encoder are made to prove our model has better performance.

articleTitle: The Cultivation of Innovative Thinking in University Computer Course
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Innovative education has become the theme of higher education in China. Educators should not only cultivate students' innovative ability, but also use effective teaching mode to cultivate students' innovative thinking. In this paper, we selected 138 students in the first grade of a university in a certain province to carry out a half-year experiment of innovative thinking teaching in the computer classroom of a university to observe whether the students' innovative thinking ability has changed or not. After a semester of teaching, the test results before and after the two classes show that the innovative thinking ability of the control class has been improved but not significant, and the students' ability of the experimental class has been improved comprehensively and significantly. The results of this study have certain enlightenment and reference value for the cultivation of innovative thinking teaching mode in Chinese college students.

articleTitle: A New Computing Design for Complex Traffic Query System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper designs it as a problem of public transportation route selection by a new computing design. If we set routes into the auto-search system of the computer, it will be convenient for the passengers to arrive at their destination by seeking out the less changing route while fully considering the cost. And we're sure that the optimum route we design can meet different requirements of the passengers.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Fingered Hand for Robotic Grasp
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As robots are gradually used in more and more scenarios, the requirements for robots to complete a variety of complex tasks are becoming higher and higher. Robotic hands, as the important tool for robot to complete the task, has attracted more and more attention. However, the robotic grasping tool usually has a single function and few degrees of freedom, which makes it difficult to adapt to more complex application scenarios. This paper presented a novel robotic hand with four fingers, which is designed based on the characteristics of human hands. We introduced the design process of the finger structure, analyzed the kinematics and statics of the designed hand, and further manufactured the prototype. To verify the function of the designed multi-fingered hand, we designed a serial of grasping experiments for different objects. The experimental results show that the designed multi-fingered hand can successfully grasp different experimental objects and meet the grasping requirements of the robot.

articleTitle: Influence of Friction on Direct-Drive Electromechanical Servo System of Optoelectronic Stabilized Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As the basic circuit of the optoelectronic stabilized platform, the performance index of the speed control loop is affected by friction coefficient of the system. Dynamics equation of single-axis servo mechanism and the frequency characteristic index of electromechanical system model are analyzed theoretically, and then the influence of friction on the frequency characteristic of the system is studied. The influence of friction on the servo performance of the system is directly analyzed through simulation analysis. The results show that changing the Coulomb friction not only affects the low frequency amplitude-frequency characteristics of the system, but also leads the phase of the middle frequency band with the increase of Coulomb friction. The effect of the viscous friction coefficient on the performance of the system is mainly reflected in the adjustment of the resonance peak. The effect of changing the viscous friction coefficient is equivalent to that of changing the damping ratio of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis on Growth Characteristics of LyciumBarbarum in Qaidam Basin from 2002 to 2015
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Lyciumbarbarum is a kind of shrub which can endure barren and drought. Its remote sensing image texture characteristics are significantly different from that of grain crops. This paper uses the maximum NDVI of MODIS images of the main Lyciumbarbarum production areas in the Qaidam Basin from 2002 to 2015 to analyze the dynamic change characteristics of the planting area of Lyciumbarbarum. The main conclusions are as follows: 1) From 2002 to 2015, the maximum NDVI of Lyciumbarbarum decreased in 2008 in the main production areas of Qaidam Basin and began to stabilize in 2010; 2) The vegetation NDVI in the main production areas of Lyciumbarbarum decreased sharply in 2008, mainly because the coverage of growing crops in the growing season was significantly greater than that of Lyciumbarbarum; 3) The Lyciumbarbarum planting in the western basin was later. Planting generally started after 2011; 4) The annual average wind speed reduction trend in the Lyciumbarbarum planting area in the past 55 years is generally greater than that in the non-Lyciumbarbarum planting area, the wind speed reduction trend in the Lyciumbarbarum planting area is more significant since 2000.

articleTitle: Improved Subpixel Amplitude Measurement of Canny Operator in Ultrasonic Frequency Vibration
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Ultrasonic frequency vibration exists widely in production and life. The measurement of its amplitude often requires expensive equipment and strict installation environment. At present, the edge detection has become one of the most active topics in the field of machine vision research. However, the detection accuracy of the traditional edge detection methods can only reach one pixel level at the highest, which can no longer meet the needs of actual measurement. A more accurate edge detection method, namely sub-pixel edge detection method, is adopte. The common Canny operator is improved and the experiment is carried out to achieve higher measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: A Magnetoelectric Heterostructure Scavenging Mechanical Energy from Hand Shaking for Portable Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Energy harvesting from human hand shaking provide a promising solution for the power supply of the portable electronic devices. In this paper, a magnetoelectric (ME) heterostructure is developed to extract mechanical energy from hand shaking. The use of a Halbach array potentially enhances the induced equivalent magnetic field of the ME transducer. Experiments are carried out using the fabricated prototype. The accelerations and the induced voltages are measured. The output voltage varies with the hand shaking frequency. Under the shaking frequency of 2.9Hz, A RMS voltage of 10.56V can be generated. The results demonstrate the practicability of the proposed energy harvester under ultra-low frequency excitation.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Mixed Experimental Teaching Mode Based on BOPPPS Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of information education technology, mixed teaching mode is widely used. This paper constructs a student-centered mixed experimental teaching mode based on BOPPPS teaching concept, combines BOPPPS teaching mode and mixed teaching mode theoretically, detailed each link of the mixed teaching activities, and realizes the effective connection of teaching activities. Then it was applied to the teaching of “Automatic Control Principle Experiment”, through student satisfaction survey and teaching effect analysis, it is shown that this teaching mode can improve students' enthusiasm to participate in the experiment, can improve students' problem-solving engineering practice ability, teamwork ability and innovative consciousness.

articleTitle: Adaptive Channel Status Based Access Class Barring Scheme in C-V2X Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In high-density C-V2X networks, an effective massive access method for group communications is the basis to assure the performance index for different services and to enhance the spectrum efficiency under limited spectrum resource. In the paper, an improved ACB scheme is proposed using channel status information based on computing ability. Firstly, the gNodeB can estimate the traffic density in single cell and generate the ACB factor. Then the gNodeB broadcasts ACB factor under cellular coverage. According to SINR and ACB factor of the received signal, the terminal on board will compute the access probability, and compare with ACB factor. When the access probability is more than ACB factor, the terminal selects a preamble randomly from unused preamble pool with the access probability or 1. The terminal transmits the selected preamble to the gNodeB for finishing the access procedure. The analysis results show that the access collision probability is a function of channel status with the traffic density as the negative component. The simulation results show that the average access collision probability is deceased about 5% - 20% compared with S-Aloha and M2M-OSA schemes in high-density scenarios, and effectively reduces the average access delay.

articleTitle: Analyses the Business Etiquette in Cross-cultural Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Due to the different nations culture, people's ideology, value standard etc. all exist great difference, therefore business etiquette behavior also different. So, in mutual contacts and exchanges always for not familiar with other countries' ethnic customs or international prevailing etiquette so that can't get enough understanding and exchanges. This topic is aimed at through contrast to analyze similarities and differences of etiquette behavior in cross-cultural and common etiquette error, and reflect the communication value of business etiquette.

articleTitle: On the Security of Privacy-Preserving Cross-Domain Authentication and Data Deduplication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Recently, Yang et al. proposed a privacy-preserving cross-domain data deduplication scheme in cloud (IEEE Transactions on Big Data, DOI 10.1109/TBDATA.2017.2721444) to achieve both privacy-preserving and data availability and to resist brute-force attacks. Their scheme was claimed to resist the brute-force attack from Cloud Server Provider. Unfortunately, in this work, we analyze the security of Yang et al. scheme, analysis indicates that their scheme can be brute-force attack, therefore, their scheme is insecure. After analyzing the reasons to produce such an attack, we suggest an improved method to overcome such an attack.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Teaching Mode of Biochemistry Course Based on Internet Thinking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information society, our way of life has undergone tremendous changes, which also provides certain ideas for traditional higher education reforms. Based on the perspective of Internet thinking, this paper optimizes the teaching mode of traditional applied undergraduate medical chemistry courses, including actively mobilizing students' initiative to participate in the teaching process, practical teaching and theoretical teaching in scientific design courses, and multi-channel expansion The teacher's innovative knowledge reserve, highlighting the key points of teaching, clarifying teaching goals and improving the resources of the biochemistry course education platform.

articleTitle: Insight into the Inhibitory Activities of Diverse Ligands for Tyrosinase Using Molecular and Structure-based Features
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Tyrosinase, which is closely related to blacking fruit and vegetable, larva development and abnormal deposition of melanin inside human skin, distribute broadly in cells of animal, plant and microorganism. Harmless inhibitors of tyrosinase can be used for lengthening storing time of fruits and vegetables, resisting insects in agriculture and cuing stain. Exploration of common pharmacophores of tyrosinase inhibitors provides ways to understand the inhibitory mechanism and design safe inhibitors. In this study, structure-based features based on MM-PBSA method and binding free energy computation were combined with molecular features to setup a descriptive relationship between tyrosinase inhibitory active and molecular structure for 46 diverse ligands. Monte Carlo and random Forest algorithms were used to build regression model for multiple variable and case. Explicit models using Monte Carlo provided 0.66, and implicit models using Random Forest afforded 0.92 for Pearson correlation coefficients (R2). By analyzing the common structure of 46 inhibitors, we found that the hydroxyl in ring B of flavonoid could binding to active site of tyrosinase directly and exhibit strong inhibitory active. Other structure similar with flavonoid could inhibit tyrosinase as well. The inhibitors including 2,4-dihydroxyphenol group at one end of molecular structure show up strongest inhibitory force.

articleTitle: A 3D Multi-Scale Multi-Attention UNet for Automatic Hippocampal Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Hippocampus is one of the first affected brain regions in Alzheimer's disease (AD). To help AD diagnosis, hippocampal atrophy have been studied extensively, but accurate segmentation of hippocampus has always been a difficult problem. In this study, we propose a 3D multi-scale multi-attention UNet with the use of multi-scale inception module, residual connections and attention modules for automatic hippocampal segmentation. Experimental results on the HarP dataset show that our proposed method can achieve average Dice coefficient of 0.827 for hippocampal segmentation, which outperform classic 3D UNet. The efficiency and accuracy of the proposed methods suggests that it may facilitate the study of the hippocampus for large-scale studies.

articleTitle: Knuckle Pattern Recognition Method Based on Improved U-net
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The information society has increasingly higher requirements for the accuracy and diversity of identity authentication. Biometric identification is a reliable method of identification, which has been widely used in real life. As a new biometric identification method, the knuckle pattern has the advantages of rich texture and high stability and bright prospects in the research of identity recognition. The traditional segmentation method has shortcomings such as breakpoints and segmentation of non-main texture features for the segmentation of complex texture information, although it is effective and simple. A knuckle pattern segmentation method based on deep learning is proposed, which is based on improved U-net. The U-net model is improved in two ways, including adding an attention mechanism to the U-net network and changing the traditional convolution into a deep separable convolution in the non-additional attention mechanism module in the model. Finally, combine the Surf algorithm to identify and match. So improved the accuracy of recognition and reduced the amount of calculation. The experimental results show that the improved U-net segmentation method used in this paper has a further improvement in the segmentation effect compared with the traditional segmentation method, and the final recognition rate is also significantly improved. The recognition rate reached 97.43%, and the single image matching time was 0.12s.

articleTitle: An Edge Device for Personal Big Data Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, we present our design of a smart wristband, iFit, which runs our customized operating system to monitor the wearer's daily activities. The smart wristband consists of a 3-axis gyroscope and a 3-axis accelerometer which records the user's motion data as six-axis time series data. We train a pattern model for different activities, such as walking, running and playing badminton. So iFit can automatically detect the types of ongoing sports and record a precise calorie consumption based on user's personal profile (e.g., weight and height).

articleTitle: Student GroupRecommendation using Extreme Learning Machinefor Collaborative Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Collaborative learning(CL) is defined as situations where several learners with different ways of thinking, acting, and feeling participate in solving common problems. Group work is a representative form of CL and a strong need for various online courses. In this study, we focus on the student group recommendation based on the personalized information of students, including learning styles and social closeness. Moreover, aneffective recommendation method using extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed in this paper. The method regards studentgroup recommendation asa binary classification problem. First, learning features are extracted from group learning styles using Felder-Silverman model and group members' social relationships. These features simultaneouslyconsider all the important factors which determine the results of recommendation and guarantee the effectiveness of grouprecommendation. Then, the extracted features are input to train ELM classifier due to its fast learning speed, whichguarantees the efficiency of recommendation. Finally, comparative experiments verify the accuracy and efficiencyof our method.

articleTitle: Research on Contemporary Neologisms from the Perspective of Multimedia
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology and the invention of new things, many new words are created, which greatly enrich the use of people's language. But among them, there are many nonstandard words which have a great impact on people's daily communication. As a mirror of social development, neologisms have attracted more and more attention from the public, scholars and experts, and become a hot topic in the field of linguistics. Based on the collection of a large number of neologisms, this paper analyzes the reasons that influence the formation of neologisms in the past 30 years. It is found that the large number of neologisms in Contemporary Chinese is the result of external social reasons, internal language structure and mass psychology.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Risk Assessment and Control System Microservice-Based Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The risk assessment and controls system plays an important role in ensuring the safety of urban rail operations. The Spring Cloud microservice architecture has the characteristics of low coupling and easy expansion. In order to solve the problem that the monolithic system cannot satisfy the needs of scientific decision-making and data sharing, this paper proposes a design process for a risk assessment and control system. The results show that the urban railway transit operation risk and control system adopting the micro-service architecture fills the blank of the urban rail risk management and control information system, provides better decision-making basis for managers, and the microservice architecture also improves the scalability and reusability of the system.

articleTitle: A Novel AR Maintenance Training System and Its Effect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) applications in aviation industry have been significant increased in recent years, especially in aviation maintenance training. The visualization and interaction capabilities of AR can impact on maintenance, but the effect of AR on training process has not been clarified. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the AR composite materials maintenance training process with eye movement data for future studies and applications. ARCM-Tutor is a prototype that integrates AR with lay-up process in bonded repair of composite structures. The laminate simulation training was conducted for a group of 16 students of safety discipline of continued airworthiness course at the Civil Aviation Flight University of China. The training was carried out based on the two different way and eye-tracking was used to record gaze data generated in this process. Then, the eye movement behavior such as first fixation time, average fixation time, saccadic velocity and pupil diameter in the process were analyzed. The correlation between eye movement and learning performance was established. The eye movement indexes including average fixation time, pupil diameter and saccade velocity, which could characterize the training effect were extracted. The fuzzy c-means clustering method was used to classify the eye movement feature vector attach to training performance. The experimental results show that this method can infer the training performance effectively.

articleTitle: Visual Communication of China's Emerging Brands
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The development of new media and new technology puts forward higher requirements for visual design, and the development of Internet technology promotes new thinking on brand visual design. The article analyzes and researches the visual communication characteristics of Florasis, a cutting-edge cosmetics brand in China, and explores how Florasis establishes a brand image through visual communication and improves brand efficiency. It is concluded that the new Chinese brand must be based on traditional Chinese culture in visual communication design. Combining modern design ideas, expressing the modernity of traditional cultural symbols, and focusing on the expression of cultural values while improving the brand's artistic aesthetics.

articleTitle: Research on the Application and Practice of Blended Teaching Mode in Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the traditional teaching model has emerged problems such as simply imparting knowledge and failing to meet students' personalized learning. Big data technology will provide richer learning resources, teaching methods and learning styles to drive new changes in education. In the era of big data, the blended teaching mode makes full use of the information-based teaching platform to break the drawbacks of the traditional teaching mode, which is of great value and significance to the reform of China's teaching mode. This paper will explore the specific application of blended teaching based on Chaoxing in practical teaching. As a blended teaching platform and analysis tool, Chaoxing can not only grasp students' learning in time and accurately complete learning evaluation, but also optimize teaching design and expand the time and space for teaching and learning. on this basis, this paper also proposes the application strategies of blended teaching mode such as increasing the strength and depth of integration of information technology and curriculum teaching in the era of big data to realize resource integration and make full use of information technology, strengthening teacher training and enhancing information technology application ability, so as to improve the quality of classroom teaching.

articleTitle: Test of the Modulation Bandwidth of the LED in Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: More and more researchers focus on visible light communication technology in recent years because of the shortage of spectrum resource. Channel capacity and data rate are depended by the modulation bandwidth of the LED. A test system of LED's modulation bandwidth is designed. This system includes two parts: transmission and reception. The transmition circuit is BiasT structure. The receiving circuit is TIA structure. The parameters of the chip were analyzed in detail. The 3dB modulation bandwidth is about 3.15MHz. The 20dB modulation bandwidth is about 8MHz. After using a blue filter lens, the 3dB modulation bandwidth is raised to about 5.5MHz. All data is the only for the sample LED.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level Semantic Fusion Algorithm Based on Historical Data in Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To solve the problem that existing machine reading comprehension models can't understand the semantics of articles and questions well, this paper proposes a multi-level semantic fusion neural network based on natural language understanding and deep learning. The model combines calculations of attentions at different levels with cross-layer fusions of historical data. Experiments on the SQuAD dataset prove that our proposed model is superior to traditional models in terms of the exact match rate and F1 value. Our model can better transmit and interpret data and enhance the performance of question answering systems.

articleTitle: Multiple Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Random Chaotic System and Bit Permutation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A new random chaotic system demonstrating good chaotic natures is constructed. A multiple image encryption algorithm based on the proposed random chaotic system and bit permutation is proposed. Firstly, two original images are synthesized into one plain-image, chaotic sequence related to plain-image and generated by random chaotic system is then applied to shuffle pixels of the plain-image. Bit permutation is also performed to permute the binary image yielded by the scrambled image. Finally, the binary image is transformed into a 8-bit gray image and a diffusion process is carried out to obtain the cipher-image. Experimental results and security analysis show that the encryption algorithm has high security and can resist various classical attacks.

articleTitle: Early Warning Mechanism and Countermeasures of Enterprise Financial Risk in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The continuous development of information technology has brought the era of big data when the pace of enterprise development was accelerated. Under this circumstance, great changes have taken place in corporate financial management, especially the optimization and reform of corporate financial work. Big data plays a prominent role in corporate financial management. It not only improves the efficiency of financial work, but also brings certain risks to financial management. Therefore, in order to effectively prevent various risks, companies should enhance their financial management awareness, build financial risk early warning mechanisms, and explore specific response strategies to ensure the smooth progress of corporate financial management.

articleTitle: Study on the Three Dimensional Evaluation Model of English Listening and Speaking in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the all-round popularization of Internet technology, with the help of various mobile intelligent terminals, the era of big data has quietly come. As an important place to cultivate practical, applied and innovative foreign language talents, College English education is facing great opportunities and challenges. Based on this, this paper analyzes the current difficulties of College English audio-visual and oral teaching, and puts forward the multi-dimensional evaluation model of English audio-visual and oral under the background of big data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radar Detection Accuracy Deviation Based on Goodness of Fit Test
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, through the analysis of the accuracy of the target information detected by the warning radar, the description of the related goodness of fit test model and the calculation of the detection reference trajectory based on the least square algorithm are given. After the track comparison, the detection track deviation of the warning radar is calculated, and then the track deviation is tested by the goodness of fit test. This method solves the problem that the hypothesis test is done under the assumption that the population is normal, but the hypothesis itself is not necessarily true, and it needs to collect samples (Χ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>,…,Χ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>) to test it. This method reduces the number of samples collected and the complexity of data fitting. An application example shows that the detection accuracy of radar can be improved by using goodness of fit test to analyze the deviation of radar detection accuracy after detecting target trajectory.

articleTitle: Automatic Image Recognition of Austenite Grain Boundary in Martensitic Metallography based on Image Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: For most steel materials, the conventional corrosion method can only observe the martensite structure after transformation. There are some problems in measuring austenite grain size, such as complex operation, difficult to ensure the corrosion quality and so on. Therefore, we use machine learning to identify the original austenite grain boundary according to the martensite structure of conventional corrosion. In this paper, image style transfer is realized by iterative method based on generating model, and austenite grain boundary recognition during martensitic transformation is realized by means of pre training network model vgg19. Firstly, the pre trained deep network vgg19 is used to extract the style and content features of martensite metallographic images. Then, the loss function of style and content is defined, and the gradient descent method is used to iterate step by step to optimize the total loss. Finally, the austenite image with clear grain boundary is obtained by texture segmentation.

articleTitle: Identification of Offshore Oil and Gas Drilling Platforms Based on Multi-source Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The ocean is rich in oil and natural gas. The struggle for maritime rights and interests is becoming increasingly fierce. High temporal and spatial dynamic monitoring of offshore oil and gas drilling platforms has becoming important for comprehensive understanding of regional resource exploitation and development. In this paper, multi-source remote sensing satellite data are applied to the identification of offshore oil and gas platforms. And, an intelligent identification model of offshore oil and gas drilling platforms based on multi-source data is proposed. Firstly, the target area of offshore oil and gas platforms were first identified by ‘Flint’ annual NPP-VIIRS night-time light data. Then, they were accurately identified by combining the characteristics of multi temporal Sentinel-1 data. Finally, they were verified by combining multi-source high-resolution remote sensing satellite data. In this paper, the model was applied on the eastern sea area of Vietnam. And 75 platforms were rightly detected.

Author Keywords: offshore oil and gas drilling platforms

articleTitle: The Non-Linear Model Research of Two-Phase Switched Reluctance Motor Basic on Interpolation and Fitting Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The switched reluctance motor characters multiple variables, significant coupling effect, and complex non-linear system carry many difficulties. A linear and quasi-linear model cannot be used to design and test controllers with strictly control performance requirements. In this paper, based on the two-phase switched reluctance motor non-linear mathematical model and the basic operating equation, a simplified non-linear mathematical model of switched reluctance motor is studied, which interpolates and fits the middle position curve based on two characteristic magnetic chain curves of the aligned and nonaligned positions of the modelled stator and rotor. The improvement method and asymmetry correction method are explored based on the asymmetry caused by the non-uniform air gap between the stator and the rotator. Finite element simulation data are used to analyse the results of the interpolation fit method to verify the rationality and accuracy of the interpolation fit method.

articleTitle: Improved Chinese Word Segmentation Algorithm of Quantitative Units in Elementary Mathematics Application Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of Chinese word segmentation (CWS) and part-of-speech (POS) tagging of quantitative units in elementary mathematics application problems, an improved CWS algorithm is proposed. By compiling the revised dictionary about the quantitative units, designing a segmentation algorithm and a merging algorithm to segment and then merge the matched target words, the problems of CWS and POS tagging of quantitative units are corrected. The experimental results show that the improved CWS algorithm can improve the accuracy of CWS and POS tagging of quantitative units to 98%.

articleTitle: A New Ship Target Detecting Method Based on Saliency in SAR Image
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) is a kind of active microwave sensor, and has been widely used in the field of ocean ship detection. Because SAR imaging is affected by the speckle noise, sea clutter and complex environment, it is still a challenging task about ship target detection in SAR image processing. In this paper a fast ship target detecting method based on saliency is proposed. Firstly, the SAR image is separated to land and sea in order to remove the influence of land scattering. In the next step, the sea candidate area is segmented by super pixels, the global and local contrast of super pixels are calculated by using Bhattacharyya dissimilarity measure, and then combine them to generate the saliency map. Finally, the Otsu algorithm is used to separate the target regions in the saliency maps. The experimental results show that the proposed method effectively suppressed the influence of sea and land clutter, enhanced the saliency of the target, which greatly improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Elderly Activity Space in Digital Community Based on Environment Perception Experience
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the rapid development of digital information society, the primary way to build a healthy China strategy is to solve the problem of population aging, which not only puts forward higher requirements for the digital renewal of the future aging community. With the help of computer electronic information technology, this study used the image features of the elderly's activity behavior to pre-detect the form of similar areas and applied them to the update of community activity space. The focus is to firstly combine the concept of environmental perception experience with the gait behavior characteristics of the elderly to carry out pedestrian gait rerecognition function, and analyze a series of behavioral needs of the elderly in the activity space and the use environment, such as the perception organs in the activity space to influence their emotion, perception consciousness and will. Then, the association between gait energy map and activity space elements is analyzed and synthesized by computer software, so as to identify and update the new functions of user identity and usability of the community activity space for the elderly in the whole cycle. Finally, the positive role of the elderly in self-management, self-education and self-service in the space is highlighted, so as to realize the symbiosis and sustainable development among space, user behavior and environment.

articleTitle: Intelligent Power Distribution Visual Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the power system of the urban platform, due to the dense urban population, the real-time monitoring and early warning power distribution cabinet system is of great significance to the safety of urban residents and reducing property losses. Therefore, combined with the dense distribution of urban electrical equipment, we designed a brand-new Internet of Things monitoring system that accurately locates the location of each power distribution cabinet in the city. Through the MQTT protocol, it realizes the data transmission between the microcontroller, server and database. On the web side, we use the current mainstream front-end vue. js and back-end SpringBoot framework. Display data in the form of 2D (echarts) and 3D (unity). The data is updated more timely, the display is more diverse, and the readability becomes stronger. Finally, we evaluated the practicability of the system in combination with the specific use situation. When the temperature and humidity reach a critical value, the system will send an early warning signal to the monitor to achieve the final effect.

articleTitle: Exercise Recommendation Method Combining NeuralCD and NeuMF Models
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Exercises are an indispensable part of the student's learning process. Students choosing appropriate exercises can improve learning efficiency and speed up learning progress. However, due to the explosive increase of exercise resources, students face difficulties in choosing suitable exercises. Therefore, this article proposes an exercise recommendation method combining NeuralCD (Neural Cognitive Diagnosis) and NeuMF (Neural Matrix Factorization Model) models, called NeuralCD-NeuMF method. First, this method uses the NeuralCD model to obtain students' knowledge point proficiency and exercises' knowledge point difficulty, outputing students' exercises mastery level. Then combined with the NeuMF model, the NeuMF incorporated students' Personality Characteristics (NeuMF-PC) model is constructed to predict students' scores on exercises. Finally, according to the difficulty level, suitable exercises are recommended to each student. The effectiveness of the NeuralCD-NeuMF method is verified through a large number of experiments.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Technology for Crawler Rescue Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 7th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
